notes: Engine schema for docs/legends-design.md section 8. Names, rules text, flavor and timings follow the art kit's data/catalog.json (content legends-starter-0.1). Cards without a safe engine implementation are disabled with a reason and never drawn. Mapping where the kit names an abstract weight: approach_weight_add becomes a closer generic-AI approach band (approach/stop px). Ticks are 60 Hz.

cards.name: MY NINJA WAY
cards.text: Equip: prefer close pressure and approach opportunities. Guard preference is slightly reduced. Replaces your active Resolve.

cards.name: SAIYAN PRIDE
cards.text: Equip: reserve native power and prefer validated super opportunities against a punishable opponent. No free damage or guaranteed hit.
cards.disabled_reason: needs adapters that tag supers and punish windows; none are verified yet

cards.name: SCARLET RESOLVE
cards.text: Equip: prefer safe spacing and counters after observed whiffs. Guard chance rises modestly, within the global clamp. No future-state knowledge.
cards.disabled_reason: whiff detection (attack that missed) is not implemented in the engine bridge

cards.name: CHIDORI
cards.text: Arm for up to 1 second. At a legal grounded opening, commit a lightning-rush echo after a short interruptible windup. One hit; no homing.
cards.flavor: A lightning rush. It can be blocked.

cards.name: SPIRIT GUN
cards.text: At a legal opening, fire a straight energy echo after an interruptible startup. One hit. It can be blocked or avoided.

cards.name: BUNGEE GUM
cards.text: Fire a tether echo. If its one hit connects, apply a short separation limit and a gentle pull. A miss or block creates no tether.
cards.disabled_reason: needs a safe way to limit fighter separation without forcing states
cards.flavor: Land a tether. Control the gap.

cards.name: KAIO-KEN
cards.text: For 6 seconds: +20% attack and more approach pressure. Lose 1% max HP each second; this strain cannot KO you. Does not speed up animation frames.

cards.name: BANKAI
cards.text: For 6 seconds: +15% attack and +25% validated native power gain. Adds an aura; transformation is allowed only through a verified character adapter.
cards.disabled_reason: power-gain scaling is not hooked yet; shipping only the attack part would not be this card

cards.name: PLUS ULTRA
cards.text: Below 35% HP: gain +10% attack for 5 seconds and reduce your next two received hits by 35%. Once per fighter. No revive or hitstun escape.

cards.name: ZA WARUDO
cards.text: After a brief telegraph, freeze the opponent's owned fighter, helpers and projectiles for 1.2 seconds. Ends at 20% max-HP damage. Both coaches are card-locked during the stop.
cards.disabled_reason: owner-scoped freezing of a fighter with its helpers and projectiles, with restoration on KO/exit, is not implemented
cards.reference: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure / DIO and The World

cards.name: SENZU BEAN
cards.text: While grounded and free to act, begin a half-second recovery. Heal 12% max HP on completion. Taking a hit interrupts it and spends the card. No revive.

cards.name: POT OF GREED
cards.text: Draw two through the bounded pending queue. Once per coach each encounter. These draws generate no Hype and obey rarity, duplicate and unique-card limits.
